subject: general
question: Which organic compounds have suffix 'al'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aldehydes**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In chemistry**, the **suffix -al **is the **IUPAC nomenclature **used in **organic chemistry **to **form names **of **aldehydes containing **the **-(CO)H group **in the **systematic form**.
 
• The **International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry (IUPAC) **is the **international body **that represents **chemistry **and **related sciences **and **technologies**.
 
• **Aldehydes **are **carbonyl compounds **found **ubiquitously **in **the environment**, **derived **from **both natural **and **anthropogenic sources**. As the **aldehydes are reactive species**.
 
 
• They **are generally toxic to the body**.
 
 
 
• The **general formula **of **an alkyl group **is **CnH2n+1 **and hence **general formula **for **aldehyde **will be **CnH2n+1CHO **provided **n = 0, 1, 2, 3**, etc.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rules of nomenclature of IUPAC**:

 
 
• Find and name the longest continuous carbon chain.
 
• Identify and name groups attached to this chain.
 
• Number the chain consecutively, starting at the end nearest a substituent group.
 
• Designate the location of each substituent group by an appropriate number and name.
 
• Then write the name of the compound according to a sequence.
